incidents.name: Parity WalletLibrary unprotected initWallet + kill
incidents.lossOther: 513,774 ETH permanently frozen across 587 Parity multisig wallets
incidents.notes: WalletLibrary was deployed uninitialised and its initWallet() was reachable on the library itself, so anyone could take ownership and call kill(), selfdestructing the shared delegatecall target and bricking every Parity multisig pointing at it.

sources.ref: onchain review: WalletLibrary 0x863DF6BFa4469f3ead0bE8f9F2AAE51c91A907b4 created 2017-07-20T16:39:46Z by 0x00caa64684700d2825da7cac6ba0c6ed9fd2a1bb, unrelated to the attack sender; no delegatecall proxy and no upgrade events, so the age is measured from deployment. Two txs from 0xae7168de hit the library: initWallet (0x05f71e1b..., 14:33:47Z) then kill (0x47f7cff7..., 15:25:21Z); the kill is the incident. Loss is frozen, not stolen, so no USD figure is asserted. 513,774 ETH x $295.24 (DefiLlama coingecko:ethereum, nearest print to incidentTimestamp 1509981921) = $151,684,169 of value frozen, not stolen.
